name: Mohammad Montasim Al Mamun Shuvo
title: Senior Software Engineer | AI-first full-stack | Real-time, AI-driven SaaS | Next.js, Node.js, TypeScript
tagline: Designing, building and shipping scalable products from idea to production.
about:
I’m a software engineer with **4+ years** of hands-on experience building web and mobile products with React, Next.js, Node.js and TypeScript. I love turning messy, real-world problems into software people can rely on.

Over the years I’ve gone from junior engineer to leading a team of **3 engineers**, building a HIPAA-compliant healthcare platform used by **1,000+ patients and clinicians**. Along the way I got **99.9%** of its AI assessment sessions finishing without a crash, while cutting the cloud bill by **70%**.

I’ve also shipped **education**, **fitness**, **customer messaging** and **AI creator** platforms. Real-time features, AI integrations, multi-tenant SaaS and cross-platform apps are what I can take from idea to production.

I plan for what can go wrong before it does, keep things simple enough for the next person to change, and share what I learn along the way. The **57 case studies** here walk through the decisions behind each project.
